text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. On one hand, it is automating repetitive tasks, like data entry or scheduling, which frees up time for more creative work. On the other, it offers powerful productivity tools that help us analyze information faster and make better decisions. However, this does not mean humans are being replaced. Instead, the focus is on human-AI collaboration, where people guide the technology and check its results. Of course, this shift brings job changes. Some roles may disappear, but new ones will appear, requiring skills like problem-solving and emotional intelligence. The future workplace will likely be a mix of human judgment and machine efficiency.
